description: The bar chart illustrates the perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different validation datasets under varying quantization bits. The x-axis represents the quantization bits, ranging from 3 to 16, while the y-axis measures perplexity. The chart includes two sets of bars, labeled 'Uniform' and 'Ours', indicating two different quantization methods. The 'Uniform' method consistently shows higher perplexity across all quantization bits compared to the 'Ours' method. The 'Ours' method demonstrates a clear trend of decreasing perplexity as the quantization bits increase, suggesting that this method is more effective in reducing perplexity with higher quantization levels.
